cv.chkw: checked against Census Bureau table B29001, the same estimate as a published table
cv.w: U.S. Census Bureau, citizen voting-age population special tabulation from the American Community Survey, 2020-2024 five-year estimates, with margins of error at 90 percent

eavs.w: U.S. Election Assistance Commission, Election Administration and Voting Survey (the states' own reports after each election)

AK.say: Alaska posts its count of ballots by kind only after the election.

AL.say: Alabama posts ballots cast, county by county, only after the election.

AR.say: Arkansas gives its early votes only inside each county's results on election night.

AZ.say: Arizona posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

CA.aw: the workbook's own date and time

CO.aw: the date of the Secretary of State's release

CT.aw: the day the Secretary of the State's news release names (it gives no time); the release calls the figures unofficial

DC.aw: ballots received through that day, the last day the Board's table gives
DC.pub: District of Columbia Board of Elections

DE.say: Delaware gives its counts by way of voting on election night.

FL.aw: when the Division compiled its state totals; each county's own time can be a few hours earlier

GA.say: Georgia posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

IA.aw: when the file says its figures were pulled

IL.say: Illinois posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

IN.say: Indiana posts ballots cast, county by county, only after the election.

KS.say: Kansas posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

KY.aw: the date in the workbook's name (it gives no time); the Board marks these numbers unofficial

LA.aw: the report's end date (it gives no time)

MA.say: Massachusetts posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

ME.aw: the date of the Secretary of State's file

MI.say: Michigan posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

MN.say: Minnesota posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

MO.say: Missouri posts no count of ballots cast before the election.

MS.say: Mississippi posts no count of ballots cast before the election.

MT.say: Montana posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

NC.aw: when the Board's file was written
NC.pub: North Carolina State Board of Elections

ND.aw: when this site read the page, since the page gives no time of its own

NE.say: Nebraska posts no count of ballots cast before the election.

NH.say: New Hampshire posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

NJ.say: New Jersey starts posting its figures later in the early voting period. They are not read here yet.

NM.say: New Mexico gives counts of ballots cast so far only as rounded figures in news releases, with no file.

NV.say: Nevada posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

NY.say: New York posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

OH.say: Ohio posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

OK.aw: the time the Board's system printed the report

OR.aw: the time the Secretary of State's file was generated; the figures are unofficial
OR.pub: Oregon Secretary of State, Elections Division

RI.say: Rhode Island posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

SC.aw: the report's own date and time, else the last early-voting day it covers

TN.say: Tennessee posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

TX.aw: the day the Secretary of State's system says it was updated

UT.say: Utah's county clerks post the ballots they have received, county by county, with no statewide figure; they are not read here.

VA.say: Virginia posts no count of ballots cast so far; its turnout by locality comes after the election.

VT.say: Vermont's town turnout comes with the results; its daily count of ballots is not public.

WA.say: Washington posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

WI.say: Wisconsin posts its figures on a page that could not be read here yet.

WV.aw: the end of the day the Secretary of State's news release names (it gives no time)

WY.say: Wyoming gives statewide absentee turnout in a news release on the eve of the election only.
